text: We were on a break!
translation: 我们当时已经分手（冷静期）了！
context_before: Monica: What are you doing here?
Ross: I came to talk to Rachel.
context_after: Rachel: You had no right to sleep with that girl!
Chandler: Oh boy, here we go again.

text: How you doin'?
translation: 近来可好啊，美女？
context_before: Rachel: Hi, I'm Rachel. I'm new here.
Joey: Oh, really? Well, let me tell you something.
context_after: Rachel: Is that your signature line?
Monica: Joey, stop it. She just got here.

text: PIVOT! PIVOT! PIVOT!
translation: 拐弯！往这边拐！拐啊！
context_before: Chandler: I can't push this couch anymore.
Ross: You just have to turn it slightly.
context_after: Chandler: SHUT UP! SHUT UP! SHUT UP!
Rachel: I don't think it's gonna pivot anymore.

text: Smelly cat, smelly cat, what are they feeding you?
translation: 臭臭猫，臭臭猫，他们到底给你喂了什么？
context_before: Monica: Phoebe, are you playing at Central Perk tonight?
Phoebe: Yes! I just finished a brand new song.
context_after: Rachel: Oh, that's... weirdly catchy.
Phoebe: Thanks! It's not his fault.

text: Could I BE any more sarcastic?
translation: 我还能再讽刺一点吗？
context_before: Monica: Chandler, can you take this seriously for once?
Chandler: I am taking it very seriously.
context_after: Monica: That tone is exactly what I'm talking about.
Joey: Honestly, I think he's got a point.

text: No uterus, no opinion.
translation: 没子宫的人，没资格发表意见。
context_before: Ross: Wait, Braxton Hicks contractions aren't even real pain, right?
Monica: Ross, tread very carefully.
context_after: Ross: I'm just reading what the parenting book says!
Monica: Seriously, Ross, stop talking.

text: I KNOW!
translation: 我知道！！
context_before: Rachel: Can you believe we always get the best couch in Central Perk?
Phoebe: And Gunther always brings our coffee first!
context_after: Chandler: And there's the volume we all love.
Joey: My ears are still ringing.

text: Joey doesn't share food!
translation: 乔伊从不跟人分享食物！
context_before: Rachel: So how did your dinner date go last night?
Joey: Everything was fine until she reached across the table for my fries.
context_after: Phoebe: You didn't let her have one single fry?
Joey: It's a rule! I ordered the muffin on the counter just for me too.

text: Unagi is a state of total awareness.
translation: “鳗鱼（Unagi）”是一种全然戒备的终极境界。
context_before: Rachel: Ross, why are you touching your temples like that?
Phoebe: Did you get another bad headache?
context_after: Rachel: Pretty sure unagi is freshwater eel at the sushi bar.
Chandler: Say it again and I'll order you with soy sauce.

text: Seven! Seven! Seven!
translation: 七！七！七！
context_before: Chandler: I really need some relationship advice here.
Rachel: Well, Monica drew a whole diagram on a napkin.
context_after: Joey: Wait, why are there numbers on that napkin?
Chandler: I think I need another cup of coffee.

text: Welcome to the real world. It sucks. You're gonna love it.
translation: 欢迎来到真实世界。它糟透了，但你会爱上它的。
context_before: Rachel: I just cut up all my credit cards.
Chandler: That must have been tough on the scissors.
context_after: Ross: We're all here for you, Rach.
Rachel: Okay, who wants coffee?Wait, I don't work here yet.

text: See? He's her lobster!
translation: 看到了吧？他就是她的那只龙虾（天生一对）！
context_before: Joey: Why do you keep calling Ross a lobster?
Phoebe: Because lobsters fall in love and mate for life!
context_after: Monica: They actually walk around the tank holding claws?
Chandler: Great, now I feel guilty about seafood.

text: Hi, I'm Chandler. I make jokes when I'm uncomfortable.
translation: 嗨，我是钱德勒。我一紧张尴尬就会讲笑话。
context_before: Rachel: Why did you just say that to her?
Monica: Honestly Chandler, you panicked.
context_after: Joey: At least you didn't do the awkward laugh.
Ross: No, he saved that for the elevator.

text: You're over me? When were you... under me?
translation: 你已经放下我了？那你什么时候……曾经喜欢过我？
context_before: Ross: Look Rachel, I'm happy for you, I've moved on.
Rachel: Wait a second, what do you mean by that?
context_after: Ross: Well, basically... the whole time.
Joey: Whoa, plot twist at the coffee table.

text: They don't know that we know they know we know!
translation: 他们还不知道我们已经知道他们知道我们知道了！
context_before: Rachel: Monica and Chandler are trying to trick us.
Joey: My brain hurts. Can we just tell them?
context_after: Phoebe: Joey, you can't say anything!
Joey: Couldn't if I wanted to.

text: Look at me! I'm Chandler! Could I BE wearing any more clothes?
translation: 快看我！我是钱德勒！我身上穿的衣服还能再多一点吗？
context_before: Chandler: Where did all my sweaters go?
Monica: Joey walked in five minutes ago looking suspiciously round.
context_after: Chandler: That is so not true.
Ross: And please stop doing lunges in my living room.

text: MY SANDWICH?! You ate MY sandwich?!
translation: 我的三明治？！你居然吃了我的感恩节三明治？！
context_before: Monica: Did someone at the museum take your lunch?
Ross: It had the Moist Maker gravy-soaked bread in the middle!
context_after: Phoebe: Remind me never to touch Ross's leftovers.
Chandler: Even the pigeons outside got scared.

text: It was eighteen pages. FRONT AND BACK!
translation: 那封信足足有十八页。还是正反两面写满的！
context_before: Ross: Look, it was five thirty in the morning and I fell asleep!
Monica: Wait, you didn't even finish reading her letter?
context_after: Ross: And by the way, Y-O-U-apostrophe-R-E means 'you are'!
Chandler: Grammar correction right now? Bold strategy, Ross.

text: I wish I could, but I don't want to.
translation: 我也很想帮忙，但我实在不想去。
context_before: Ross: Hey Pheebs, want to help us move some boxes this afternoon?
Joey: Yeah, there's free pizza at the end.
context_after: Monica: Well, at least she's honest.
Rachel: Honestly, I respect that energy.

text: It's a moo point. Like a cow's opinion—it doesn't matter.
translation: 这叫“哞”点（无意义的观点）。就像奶牛的意见一样——根本无所谓。
context_before: Rachel: Do you think he's going to call me back?
Joey: If he doesn't, it's all a moo point anyway.
context_after: Rachel: Have I been hanging out with you too long, or did that just make sense?
Chandler: Don't listen to him, it's 'moot', not 'moo'.
